name: UpFix
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce ONE corrected full-body BACK-VIEW walking pose for the female mage in the reference. This replaces ONLY slot1, the top-row SECOND woman, not the entire sheet. Transparent background.
Keep the SAME woman's pure navy long hair, ivory headband, back view, bare arms, sleeveless blue dress, ivory edging, rose sash and navy boots. Same compact pixel-art scale and silhouette. Head, shoulders and waist stay level and centered.
Critical leg correction: RIGHT leg is the straight SUPPORT LEG, its navy boot touches the ground clearly to the RIGHT of the waist centerline (boot center about 10% of body width to the right). LEFT knee bends and LEFT boot lifts distinctly upward to the LEFT, with its complete toe and heel visible outside the skirt hem. There must be TWO CLEAR SEPARATE BOOTS, one LOWER RIGHT planted and one UPPER LEFT raised. The raised left boot should end about 15% of total sprite height above the planted boot. Open the split skirt just enough to expose both lower legs without changing its garment design. Do not hide the lifted left foot in the dress or make both boots merge into a single central leg. Show the lower legs separated by transparent space.
Use only five matte colors #172638 #3976b5 #e4e1c8 #dda77d #a9687a, no highlights or gradients, no bright hair marks apart from intentional headband. Natural small opposed arm swing, no weapon, no staff. Hard crisp pixel edges, tidy clusters. One isolated complete figure only, generous transparent margins, no labels, ground, shadows or spell effects.
